name: Door Interstage (Between Coats)
intent: Inspect cured first finish coat, light sand, patch any defects, clean dust before second coat. Doors get sanded between coats for ALL quality tiers (like trim) because doors take a high-sheen finish that magnifies any surface defects.
doctrine: Door interstage fires for all QTs because residential doors take a satin or semigloss finish that reveals nibs and runs. Sand rate (8 sides/hr) matches the prep sand rate — same physical work, different timing in the sequence. This module sits between two finish-coat invocations in the scenario module list.
